children: Indonesia raised 12 trillion rupiah ($680.85 million) from an Islamic bond auction on Tuesday, higher than the indicative target of 10 trillion rupiah, its finance ministry said.
Total incoming bids stood at 26.14 trillion rupiah, higher than the 23.54 trillion rupiah at the previous auction on August 26.
